summary: Actelis Networks filed a routine Form 8-K on October 15, 2026, furnishing an investor presentation under Item 7.01 (Regulation FD) and updating disclosure channels under Item 8.01. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing is a routine investor-communications current report rather than a special situation, with no deal terms, structural mechanics, regulatory clock, or overhang to analyze. No risk-arb angle applies; watch only for ordinary business and financing updates.
